title: Untappd Rating Drift by Beer Style
dataSources: Fermentation gravity/temperature (`brew:fermentation`), kegerator pours (`kegerator:pour`), wine-cellar climate (`winecellar:reading`).
app: Fermentation sensors (Tilt/iSpindel hydrometer, temperature), kegerator flow meters and scales, and wine-cellar climate sensors via MQTT and Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=untappd:checkin
stats avg(rating) as avg_rating by beer_style
sort avg_rating
description: Compares Untappd ratings across homebrew styles brewed.
value: Surfacing untappd rating drift by beer style helps you act before small issues become habits.
implementation: Ingest the relevant homebrewing, beer & wine export into `index=personal` and schedule this search weekly.
visualization: Table or chart of key fields.
grandmaExplanation: It treats when untappd rating drift by beer style matters for your routine.
